guide.managerIntro: Connect Claude, ChatGPT or Codex to read this workspace's clients, posts and content ideas.
guide.memberIntro: Connect Claude or ChatGPT to your account. The assistant only accesses what your role allows in this workspace.

clientIntro.claude: No key needed: the connection uses OAuth and can be revoked here at any time.
clientIntro.chatgpt: No key needed: the connection uses OAuth. Requires ChatGPT's developer mode (no paid plan required).
clientIntro.codex: Codex CLI connects with an API key for this workspace, directly over HTTP (no extra dependencies).

claudeSteps.step1: In claude.ai or Claude Desktop, open Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector.
claudeSteps.step2: Paste the URL below, leave the OAuth fields blank and click Add.
claudeSteps.step3: Sign in to Mesaas, choose the workspace and the permissions, and click Authorize.

chatgptSteps.step1: In ChatGPT, open Settings → Security and login and turn on Developer mode (an option marked "elevated risk"; also available under Settings → Plugins).
chatgptSteps.step2: Open chatgpt.com/plugins, click the + button and, in the New Plugin dialog, name it "Mesaas", paste the URL below into MCP Server URL and choose OAuth as the authentication.
chatgptSteps.step3: Optional: to show the connector with our brand, download the Mesaas logo (PNG) and upload it in the Icon field. The icon can only be set in this step: once the connector is created, it can't be changed.
chatgptSteps.step4: Check the risk confirmation, click Create and then Sign in with Mesaas: sign in, choose the workspace and the permissions, and click Authorize.
chatgptSteps.step5: In the chat, click the + button in the message field and turn on Mesaas.

codexSteps.step1: Create a key under API keys below and copy its value (it is shown only once).
codexSteps.step2: Add the block below to <c>~/.codex/config.toml</c>, replacing <c>YOUR_KEY</c> with the key you copied.
codexSteps.step3: Open Codex and check with /mcp that the mesaas server is listed.

guide.claudeKeyNote: Claude Code, the API or headless agents use a key: create one under API keys below and copy the ready-made command.
guide.codexHeadersNote: Use <c>http_headers</c> as in the block: the <c>bearer_token</c> field is not accepted for HTTP servers.
guide.tryIt: Then ask the assistant: "list my active clients" or "show post X with metrics".
guide.keyUsageNote: This key is for Claude Code, Codex, the API or headless agents. In claude.ai, Claude Desktop or ChatGPT, connect through the connector (no key): see "How to connect".
